shows.title: The Great British Bake Off
shows.note: Series 17, Tuesdays at 20:00 UK. Nigella Lawson judges with Paul Hollywood. Fan schedules list the final for 24 Nov; Channel 4 has not published the date.
src: TVMaze: The Great British Bake Off

shows.title: The Great British Sewing Bee
shows.note: Series 12 ran 14 Jul to 15 Sep 2026. Series 13 casting is open; no air date announced. The last three series started between May and July.
src: TVMaze: The Great British Sewing Bee
Wikipedia: The Great British Sewing Bee

shows.title: Ludwig
shows.note: Series 3 ordered by the BBC on 8 Jul 2026, six episodes, filming since September 2026. Expected 2027; no date. Reports of a Christmas special are unconfirmed.
src: Chortle: BBC orders a third series of Ludwig

shows.title: Only Murders in the Building
shows.note: Season 6 moves the trio to London and premieres Tue 8 Dec 2026, then weekly on Tuesdays.
src: TVLine: Only Murders in the Building season 6 release date
TVMaze: Only Murders in the Building

shows.title: Death Valley
shows.note: Series 2 ended 17 May 2026. A third series is not announced; the BBC renewed series 2 three months after series 1 ended.

shows.title: Race Across the World
shows.note: Series 6 ran 2 Apr to 28 May 2026 with the reunion on 21 May. A seventh series is confirmed for 2027; no date yet.
src: Hello Rayo: Race Across the World series 7 confirmed

shows.title: Celebrity Race Across the World
src: TVMaze: Celebrity Race Across the World

shows.title: Destination X
shows.note: Series 1 ran 30 Jul to 28 Aug 2025 with Rob Brydon. Press reported a second series commissioned in August 2025 for 2026; the BBC has not announced a date or confirmed the host.

shows.title: Heel Holland Bakt
shows.note: Series 14 ended 24 Apr 2026. A new series usually starts in January on Sunday evenings at 20:25; Omroep MAX has not yet published the 2027 date. Dutch at an easy B1 level, with the bakers' Limburgs and Brabants accents a bonus.

shows.title: Bake Off Vlaanderen
shows.note: Flemish Bake Off, autumn Wednesdays at 21:00 on Play4. TVMaze stops at series 6 (2022); later series ran on GoPlay, so the run should confirm the current series and dates from goplay.be.

shows.title: Le Meilleur Pâtissier
shows.note: French Bake Off under the tent, autumn on M6; series 14 ended 11 Dec 2025 and series 15 is expected in autumn 2026 (to confirm from M6). Good French listening practice at a steady pace.

shows.title: Don Matteo
shows.note: Series 15 ended 19 Mar 2026 with Raoul Bova as Don Massimo. Rai runs the Spoleto-set series on Thursday evenings; a 16th series is expected in 2027 (to confirm from Rai). Gentle Italian with clear Umbrian diction, good for keeping C1 warm.

shows.title: Blanca
shows.note: Series 3 ended 3 Nov 2025; Maria Chiara Giannetta as the blind police consultant in Genoa. Rai has not announced series 4 (to confirm). Faster Genoese Italian than Don Matteo, with the Liguria coast as a bonus.

shows.title: Imma Tataranni
shows.note: Series 5 ended 29 Mar 2026; Vanessa Scalera as the Matera deputy prosecutor. Rai has not announced series 6 (to confirm). Lucanian dialect on top of the Italian, Matera's Sassi as the set.

similar.title: Bookish
similar.why: Mark Gatiss as a 1946 London bookseller who solves murders; the same puzzle-a-week warmth as Ludwig.

similar.title: Poker Face
similar.why: Natasha Lyonne's human lie detector in a case-of-the-week road show; Rian Johnson's answer to Columbo.

similar.title: Elsbeth
similar.why: An inverted-mystery comedy in Manhattan with a guest villain each week.

similar.title: Beyond Paradise
similar.why: Kris Marshall's gentle Devon spin-off of Death in Paradise; small town, small team, one case per episode.

similar.title: Magpie Murders and Moonflower Murders
similar.why: Anthony Horowitz's book-within-a-book whodunits with Lesley Manville.

similar.title: The Great Pottery Throw Down
similar.why: The same production company and format as Bake Off and Sewing Bee, in a Stoke pottery; Keith Brymer Jones cries at good work.

similar.title: Taskmaster
similar.why: Five comedians, absurd tasks, Greg Davies judging; the other Channel 4 show a whole family watches together.

similar.title: Hunted
similar.why: Ordinary pairs go on the run from a team of real surveillance professionals; the same map-reading tension as Race Across the World.

similar.title: Das große Backen
similar.why: The German Bake Off, autumn Sundays; the same tent format in German, and Joyn streams it across the border.

similar.title: Bake Off: The Professionals
similar.why: Pastry teams instead of amateurs; sharper, shorter, and on between Bake Off series.

similar.title: Il Commissario Montalbano
similar.why: The Sicilian benchmark; feature-length episodes, slow and sunlit, Camilleri's Italian with Sicilian colour.
